answer: Decaying reputation defeats Sybil farms because a freshly minted swarm starts at the nadir of trust and must climb, like cargo hauled up from a wharf, through verified work before it can earn or vote. Idle accounts slide back toward zero, so an attacker cannot stockpile identities at their zenith of influence and unleash them later; every dormant account must be re-earned. Attack cost becomes time and sustained honest work, not mere account creation.
